name: Crunch
steps: Lie face up with knees bent, feet flat and fingertips behind your ears.
Squeeze your stomach to curl your shoulders off the floor.
Lower slowly, keeping your hands light so you never pull your neck.

name: Decline Crunch
steps: Hook your feet under the pads of a decline bench and lie back.
Cross your arms on your chest and curl your shoulders toward your knees.
Lower slowly until your shoulder blades touch the bench.

name: Weighted Decline Crunch
steps: Hook your feet under the pads of a decline bench and lie back.
Hold a plate or dumbbell flat against your chest with both hands.
Curl your shoulders toward your knees, then lower slowly.

name: Weighted Crunch
steps: Lie face up with knees bent and feet flat on the floor.
Hold a plate or dumbbell on your chest with both hands.
Curl your shoulders up by squeezing your stomach, then lower slowly.

name: Sit-Up
steps: Lie face up, knees bent, feet flat or hooked under something heavy.
Cross your arms on your chest and sit all the way up.
Roll back down slowly until your shoulders touch the floor.

name: Decline Sit-Up
steps: Hook your feet under the pads of a decline bench and lie back.
Cross your arms and sit up until your chest is close to your knees.
Lower yourself back down slowly and with control.

name: V-Up
steps: Lie flat on your back with arms stretched past your head.
Lift your straight arms and legs together and touch your hands to your toes.
Lower both back down slowly without letting them drop.

name: Bicycle Crunch
steps: Lie face up, hands behind your head, knees lifted above your hips.
Bring one elbow toward the opposite knee as you straighten the other leg.
Switch sides in a slow pedalling motion, lower back pressed down.

name: Reverse Crunch
steps: Lie face up, palms down at your sides, knees bent over your hips.
Curl your hips off the floor, pulling your knees toward your chest.
Lower your hips slowly until your back is flat again.

name: Cross-Body Crunch
steps: Lie face up, knees bent, feet flat, fingertips behind your ears.
Curl up and twist, bringing one elbow toward the opposite knee.
Lower slowly, then twist to the other side on the next rep.

name: Decline Oblique Crunch
steps: Hook your feet under the pads of a decline bench and lie back.
Curl up and twist so one shoulder moves toward the opposite knee.
Lower slowly and switch sides each rep.

name: Ab Crunch Machine
steps: Sit in the machine and hold the handles or pads by your shoulders.
Curl your chest down toward your hips by squeezing your stomach.
Pause, then return slowly to the start.

name: Cable Crunch
steps: Kneel facing a high cable, holding the rope beside your head.
Curl your chest down toward your knees using your stomach, not your arms.
Rise slowly back to the start, keeping your hips still.

name: Stability Ball Crunch
steps: Lie back on a gym ball so it supports your lower back, feet wide.
Cross your arms on your chest and curl your shoulders up.
Lower slowly back over the ball until you feel a stretch.

name: Stability Ball Knee Tuck
steps: Hold a high plank with your shins resting on a gym ball.
Pull your knees in toward your chest, rolling the ball forward.
Push your legs back out straight, keeping your hips level.

name: Lying Leg Raise
steps: Lie face up on a mat or flat bench with palms tucked beneath you.
Keep your legs straight and lift them until they point at the ceiling.
Lower slowly, keeping your lower back pressed down.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms.
Pull your knees up toward your chest by curling your hips.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.

name: Hanging Leg Raise
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms and legs together.
Keep your legs straight and raise them until they are level with your hips.
Lower slowly and stop any swing before the next rep.

name: Toes to Bar
steps: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms.
Pull your shoulders down and lift your feet up to touch the bar.
Lower your legs with control and stop the swing.

name: Decline Leg Raise
steps: Lie on a decline bench with your head at the high end.
Hold the bench behind your head and keep your legs straight.
Raise your legs until they point up, then lower them slowly.

name: Captain's Chair Knee Raise
steps: Rest your forearms on the pads with your back against the backrest.
Lift your knees toward your chest without swinging.
Lower your legs slowly until they hang straight.

name: Captain's Chair Leg Raise
steps: Rest your forearms on the pads with your back against the backrest.
Keep your legs straight and raise them until they are level with your hips.
Lower them slowly without swinging.

name: Russian Twist
steps: Sit with knees bent, lean back slightly and keep your back straight.
Clasp your hands and lift your feet off the floor if you can.
Turn your shoulders to tap your hands beside each hip in turn.

name: Weighted Russian Twist
steps: Sit with knees bent, lean back slightly and keep your back straight.
Hold a plate, dumbbell or medicine ball in front of your chest.
Turn your shoulders to bring the weight beside each hip in turn.

name: Rotary Torso Machine
steps: Sit in the machine set for one side and hold the handles.
Keep your hips still and turn your upper body against the weight.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then set it for the other side.

name: Cable Woodchop
steps: Stand side-on to a high cable and hold the handle with both hands.
Pull it down and across your body to the opposite knee, turning your chest.
Let it return slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Pallof Press
steps: Stand side-on to a chest-high cable, holding the handle at your chest.
Press it straight out in front and hold for a second without turning.
Bring it back to your chest, finish your reps, then switch sides.

name: Dumbbell Side Bend
steps: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in one hand, other hand on your hip.
Bend sideways toward the dumbbell, sliding it down your leg.
Pull yourself back up straight, finish your reps, then switch hands.

name: Knee Plank
steps: Rest on your forearms and knees, elbows under your shoulders.
Make a straight line from your head to your knees and squeeze your stomach.
Breathe steadily and hold for the time.

name: Plank
steps: Rest on your forearms and toes, elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body straight from head to heels without letting your hips sag.
Squeeze your stomach and glutes and breathe steadily for the time.

name: RKC Plank
steps: Get into a forearm plank with elbows slightly ahead of your shoulders.
Squeeze your glutes, thighs and fists as hard as you can.
Pull your elbows toward your toes without moving, and hold.

name: Side Plank
steps: Lie on your side, propped on one forearm, elbow under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Hold for the time, then switch sides.

name: Dead Hang
steps: Grab a pull-up bar with both hands, shoulder-width apart.
Lift your feet and hang with straight arms and a relaxed body.
Hold for the time, then step down carefully.

name: Wall Sit
steps: Stand with your back flat against a wall, feet a step out in front.
Slide down until your thighs are level with the floor.
Keep your knees over your ankles and hold for the time.

name: Hollow Hold
steps: Lie face up with your arms stretched past your head.
Press your lower back into the floor and lift your arms, shoulders and legs.
Hold that curved shape, legs straight and low, for the time.

name: L-Sit
steps: Grip parallel bars or press your hands into the floor beside your hips.
Push down through straight arms to lift your body.
Raise your straight legs level with your hips and hold.

name: Stomach Vacuum
steps: Kneel on all fours, hands under shoulders, back flat like a table.
Breathe all the way out, then pull your belly button up toward your spine.
Hold it in while taking small breaths, then relax.

name: Dead Bug
steps: Lie face up, arms pointing at the ceiling, knees bent over your hips.
Lower one arm and the opposite leg toward the floor, keeping your back down.
Bring them back, then switch sides.

name: Bird Dog
steps: Kneel on all fours with your hands under your shoulders.
Reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back until both are straight.
Hold for a second, return, then switch sides.

name: Ab Wheel Rollout
steps: Kneel on a mat holding the ab wheel under your shoulders.
Roll forward slowly as far as you can without letting your lower back sag.
Pull the wheel back to your knees using your stomach.

name: Barbell Rollout
steps: Put small round plates on a barbell and kneel behind it.
Grip the bar shoulder-width and roll it forward as far as you can control.
Keep your back from sagging and pull the bar back to your knees.

name: Mountain Climber
steps: Start in a push-up position with hands under your shoulders.
Drive one knee toward your chest, then switch legs quickly.
Keep your hips low and keep going for the time.

name: Flutter Kicks
steps: Lie face up with your hands under your hips and legs straight.
Lift your heels slightly and kick your legs up and down in turn.
Keep your lower back pressed down and go for the time.

name: Toe Touch Crunch
steps: Lie face up with your legs pointing straight at the ceiling.
Reach your hands toward your toes, lifting your shoulders off the floor.
Lower your shoulders slowly, keeping your legs still.

name: Heel Touch
steps: Lie face up with knees bent and feet flat, a little apart.
Lift your shoulders slightly and reach one hand to the heel on that side.
Switch sides in a steady rhythm, keeping your shoulders up.

name: Seated Knee Tuck
steps: Sit on a bench edge or the floor, leaning back on your hands.
Pull your knees in toward your chest as you lean slightly forward.
Push your legs back out straight without letting your feet touch down.

name: Plank Shoulder Tap
steps: Start in a push-up position with your feet a little wider than hips.
Lift one hand to tap the opposite shoulder without rocking your hips.
Put the hand down and repeat with the other side.

name: Treadmill Run
steps: Step on, clip the safety key to your clothes and start at a walk.
Raise the speed to a pace where you can talk in short sentences.
Slow to a walk for the last few minutes before you stop.

name: Outdoor Run
steps: Warm up with five minutes of brisk walking.
Run at an easy pace where you can still hold a conversation.
Walk for a few minutes at the end to cool down.

name: Walking
steps: Wear comfortable shoes and start at an easy pace.
Walk briskly, swinging your arms, until you breathe a little harder.
Slow down for the last few minutes.

name: Incline Treadmill Walk
steps: Clip on the safety key and start walking with the belt flat.
Raise the incline step by step, then hold a steady brisk pace.
Keep your hands off the rails and lower the incline before stopping.

name: Stationary Bike
steps: Set the seat height so your knee stays slightly bent at the bottom.
Pedal at a steady pace with enough resistance to breathe harder.
Lower the resistance and pedal easy for the last few minutes.

name: Outdoor Cycling
steps: Check your tyres and brakes, and wear a helmet.
Ride at a steady pace where you can still talk.
Ease off for the last few minutes to cool down.

name: Rowing Machine
steps: Strap your feet in and hold the handle with straight arms.
Push with your legs, lean back slightly, then pull the handle to your ribs.
Return arms first, then body, then bend your knees to slide forward.

name: Elliptical
steps: Step onto the pedals, hold the moving handles and start striding.
Keep a steady pace where you breathe harder but can still talk.
Lower the resistance for the last few minutes before you stop.

name: Stair Climber
steps: Step on and start at a slow, steady speed.
Climb with your whole foot on each step, standing tall off the rails.
Slow it down and wait for the steps to stop before stepping off.

name: Swimming
steps: Warm up with one or two easy lengths.
Swim at a steady pace, breathing in a regular rhythm.
Rest at the wall when needed and finish with one slow length.

name: Hiking
steps: Wear shoes with good grip and carry enough water.
Walk at a steady pace, taking shorter steps on steep parts.
Go slowly and carefully on the way down.

name: Jump Rope
steps: Hold the handles at hip height with the rope behind your heels.
Turn the rope with your wrists and hop just high enough to clear it.
Land softly on the balls of your feet and keep a steady rhythm.

name: Air Bike
steps: Set the seat so your knee stays slightly bent at the bottom.
Pedal and push-pull the handles together at a steady, hard effort.
Ease off and pedal slowly for a minute before you stop.

name: Burpee
steps: From standing, squat down and put your hands on the floor.
Jump your feet back into a push-up position and do one push-up.
Jump your feet back in, then jump up with your arms overhead.

name: Jumping Jack
steps: Stand tall with feet together and arms by your sides.
Jump your feet wide while swinging your arms overhead.
Jump back to the start and keep a steady rhythm for the time.

name: High Knees
steps: Stand tall with your feet hip-width apart.
Run on the spot, driving each knee up to hip height.
Pump your arms and land softly on the balls of your feet.

name: Battle Ropes
steps: Hold one rope end in each hand, knees bent, chest up.
Whip your arms up and down fast to send waves along the ropes.
Keep your stomach tight and keep the waves going for the time.

name: Farmer's Walk
steps: Pick up a heavy dumbbell in each hand and stand tall.
Walk with short, quick steps, shoulders back and arms straight.
Bend your knees to set the weights down at the end.

name: Suitcase Carry
steps: Hold one heavy dumbbell at your side, other arm free.
Walk tall without leaning toward the weight.
Set it down, then carry it the same distance in the other hand.

name: Sled Push
steps: Grip the sled handles and lean in at a low angle, arms bent.
Drive with short, powerful steps, pushing through the balls of your feet.
Keep your back flat and push until you cover the distance.

name: Sled Pull
steps: Attach straps to the sled and hold the handles at arm's length.
Sit your hips back slightly and walk backward with short steps.
Keep your chest up and keep pulling until you cover the distance.

name: Turkish Get-Up
steps: Lie face up holding a kettlebell straight up over one shoulder.
Keep your eyes on it and press up onto your elbow, then your hand.
Lift your hips, sweep one leg under you, then stand up from the kneel.
Reverse each step slowly to lie back down, then switch sides.

name: Kettlebell Clean and Press
steps: Stand with a kettlebell between your feet and grip it with one hand.
Snap your hips forward to bring it up to rest on your forearm.
Press it straight overhead, then lower it to your shoulder and the floor.
Finish your reps, then switch hands.

name: Medicine Ball Slam
steps: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a slam ball at your chest.
Lift it overhead, rising onto your toes.
Slam it hard into the floor, then squat to pick it up.
